property_summary: The owner must be set to the newOwner argument passed to transferOwnership.
After calling owned(), the owner must not be the zero address.
After calling owned(), the owner must be the same as the newOwner argument last passed to transferOwnership.
After a call to owned(), msg.sender still equals the owner, because only the owner can run owned().
After calling owned() through a non-owner address, the owner state variable remains unchanged.
